objective: Define a deterministic, fail-closed authority for analytics dataThrough, dependency watermarks, canonical closed-window selection and fresh/stale/unavailable state without inventing operational TTLs.

rootCause.helperGap: ANA-A05 has an applyFreshness helper that accepts an ad hoc maxLagSeconds but there is no canonical policy registry, dependency-watermark contract or canonical latest-window selector.
rootCause.runtimeGap: ANA-A04 compute_analytics_order_health_v1 currently reports dataThrough=windowEnd and projectionState=authoritative without proving that every canonical dependency is materialized through that boundary.
rootCause.evidenceGap: ANA-A06 proved why selection cannot cherry-pick an older non-empty passing window when a newer canonical observation exists.

dataThroughAuthority.definition: Greatest timestamp through which all canonical dependencies required by the selected metric snapshot are proven materialized; it is never inferred from computedAt or from max(event timestamp).
dataThroughAuthority.dependencyRule: canonical dataThrough is bounded by the minimum dependency watermark and windowEnd

windowSelection.precondition: candidate rows belong to the same metricKey, metricVersion and dimension set

evaluation.thresholdComparison: stale when lagSeconds > maxLagSeconds; fresh otherwise after full window coverage

thresholdAuthority.reason: ANA-A07 still forbids any implicit global maxLagSeconds. liquidity.active_service_seconds v1 now has an explicit versioned revision-1 policy with maxLagSeconds=360; metrics without an approved metric-specific policy continue to fail closed.

invariants: Freshness is based on dataThrough and explicit dependency watermarks, never computedAt alone.
An empty metric window does not become stale merely because sample_count is zero.
The latest canonical closed window is selected before freshness is evaluated; older fresh/pass windows are never used as fallback.
A metric cannot be fresh when its dataThrough is before windowEnd.
A declared dataThrough later than a dependency watermark is unavailable rather than silently clamped into authority.
Missing threshold policy fails closed as unavailable.
stale or unavailable dependencies propagate without being converted to authoritative.
Freshness state does not change transactional source authority or repair source-domain facts.
activationRequirements: server-authoritative source-domain watermarks for every required dependency
runtime projection path that derives dataThrough from dependency watermarks instead of assuming windowEnd
controlled staging tests for fresh, stale, unavailable, empty-window and no-cherry-pick selection cases
preservedBoundaries: Product Analytics remains distinct from operational observability.
A06 structural data-quality PASS remains separate from A07 freshness state.
ORD, CAT and PAY remain canonical owners of their source facts.
Browser analytics remains disabled by default.
LEGAL-B03 remains authoritative for consent, retention, anonymization and holder rights.
PAY-backed metrics remain unavailable until PAY authority is canonical.

maturity.reason: A07 remains the canonical freshness/window-selection contract. For liquidity.active_service_seconds, the metric-specific r1 threshold, CAT watermark and post-effective staging behavior are now active and certified; other ANA metrics still require their own thresholds/runtime evidence, so ANA remains 3/6.
